name: Yun Yenfei
source:
Position of the mark: On her left shoulder
Curse: [spoiler]Forbidden to be exposed to direct sunlight[/spoiler]
Gift: [spoiler]Ability to magnify an emotion or a feeling[/spoiler]

The well-famed "vampire" in the underground crime community. She induces crippling fear to subdue her enemies. Seasoned from the horrors of the world's cruelty, she grow cold and merciless. She has an outstanding loyalty towards her boss, the one who save her from all the hardships in her childhood.
